name: investment-gather-judge
description: Enforced research/judge separation for financial decisions. Phase 1: small model creates research brief. Phase 2: parallel small-model workers gather evidence ONLY (decisions field must be empty). Phase 3: big model judges evidence in fresh context (receives only evidence packets, never worker contexts). Phase 4: medium model adversarially verifies the recommendation. Args: question=<investment question>, symbols=<comma-separated tickers>

question.description: The investment question to research and decide on
